summary_en: Disclosure filed June 26, 2026 outlining CHANGE Holdings' strategy to embed capital cost and share price awareness into management decisions. Specific COC targets and KPI metrics not disclosed in available excerpt.
title_en: Response Measures Toward Realizing Management Focused on Capital Cost and Share Price
translation_en_brief: CHANGE Holdings filed a strategic disclosure on June 26, 2026 titled 'Response Measures Toward Realizing Management Focused on Capital Cost and Share Price.' The document outlines the company's framework to integrate capital cost and stock price awareness into its business management approach. The filing is structured around three pillars: current-state analysis, enterprise value enhancement measures and initiatives, and investor dialogue. Specific numeric targets (ROE thresholds, payout ratios, execution timelines, or KPI weightings) are not visible in the available excerpt. A full review of subsequent pages would be required to extract concrete COC metrics or performance benchmarks.
